evidence.decision: Selects adaptations from available width/height/locale/text rather than device names and preserves relationships, safe regions, idiom and selected task across reflow.
evidence.artifact: Requires changed constraints/layouts or implementation plus a tested/proposed environment matrix.
evidence.transformation: Reading list replaces fixed bottom Delete and one-line rows with flow-based wrapping, reachable secondary actions and retained selected article during sidebar collapse.
evidence.verification: Checks lost actions, detached relationships, hardware/bar overlap and changed task meaning; records dimensions instead of claiming native safe-area execution.
evidence.applicability: Preserves offscreen Mac-bottom risk, TV overscan/focus room, limited Watch rows and resizable spatial bounds without universalizing platform numbers.
evidence.handoffs: Routes text expansion to Typography, direction to Right to left and 3D anchoring/scaling to Spatial layout.
evidence.distinctiveness: Environment-dependent relationship-preserving reflow directly produces constraints and transition behavior.
